feature: Electronic Batch Record Review and Approval

TD-CS-53-001.name: Valid Batch Record — All In-Spec Results, No Deviations
TD-CS-53-001.expectedOutcome: Batch record approved successfully; status = APPROVED; EBR document number generated; batch eligible for Unrestricted-Use stock transfer

TD-CS-53-002.name: Valid Batch Record — Out-of-Spec Result with Approved Deviation
TD-CS-53-002.expectedOutcome: Batch record approved successfully despite out-of-spec result; approved deviation linked; status = APPROVED; EBR document number generated

TD-CS-53-003.name: Archived Batch Record — For Retrieval
TD-CS-53-003.expectedOutcome: Archived batch record retrieved successfully; all data intact; electronic signature details visible; read-only access enforced

TD-CS-53-004.name: Valid Batch Record — With Reviewer Comments
TD-CS-53-004.expectedOutcome: Batch record approved successfully; reviewer comments saved and visible; status = APPROVED; EBR document number generated

TD-CS-53-NEG-001.name: Invalid Batch Record — Missing Mandatory In-Process Control Result
TD-CS-53-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Mandatory in-process control result missing; approval blocked; status remains PENDING

TD-CS-53-NEG-002.name: Invalid Batch Record — Out-of-Spec Result Without Deviation
TD-CS-53-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Out-of-spec result without approved deviation; approval blocked; status remains PENDING

TD-CS-53-NEG-003.name: Unauthorized User — No QA Authorization
TD-CS-53-NEG-003.expectedOutcome: System displays authorization error; Review Batch Records app inaccessible; no batch record data visible

TD-CS-53-NEG-004.name: Stock Transfer Blocked — Batch Record Not Approved
TD-CS-53-NEG-004.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Batch release pending; stock transfer blocked; batch remains in Restricted-Use stock

TD-CS-53-ERR-001.name: Missing Process Order Number
TD-CS-53-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Process Order is required; field highlighted; batch record loading blocked

TD-CS-53-ERR-002.name: Missing Batch Number
TD-CS-53-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Batch Number is required; field highlighted; batch record loading blocked

TD-CS-53-ERR-003.name: Missing Electronic Signature Password
TD-CS-53-ERR-003.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Password is required; field highlighted; electronic signature blocked; status remains PENDING

TD-CS-53-ERR-004.name: Invalid Electronic Signature Password
TD-CS-53-ERR-004.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Invalid password; authentication failed; electronic signature blocked; status remains PENDING

TD-CS-53-ERR-005.name: Non-existent Process Order Number
TD-CS-53-ERR-005.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Process Order does not exist; field highlighted; batch record loading blocked

TD-CS-53-ERR-006.name: Non-existent Batch Number
TD-CS-53-ERR-006.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Batch does not exist; field highlighted; batch record loading blocked

TD-CS-53-ERR-007.name: Process Order Not TECO Status
TD-CS-53-ERR-007.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Process Order not technically complete; approval disabled; status remains PENDING

TD-CS-53-EDGE-001.name: Batch Record — Zero Deviations (Boundary Lower)
TD-CS-53-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: Batch record approved successfully; zero deviations is valid state; status = APPROVED

TD-CS-53-EDGE-002.name: Batch Record — Maximum Comments Length (Boundary Upper)
TD-CS-53-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: Batch record approved successfully; 255-character comments saved without truncation; status = APPROVED

TD-CS-53-INT-001.name: PP-QM Integration — Batch Record Data Compilation
TD-CS-53-INT-001.expectedOutcome: Batch record compiled successfully; PP data (operations, components) and QM data (inspection lot, results) integrated correctly

TD-CS-53-INT-002.name: MM-QM Integration — Batch Release and Stock Transfer
TD-CS-53-INT-002.expectedOutcome: Batch record approved; batch released; stock transfer to Unrestricted-Use executed successfully; goods movement document created

TD-CS-53-INT-003.name: 21 CFR Part 11 Compliance — Electronic Signature Verification
TD-CS-53-INT-003.expectedOutcome: Electronic signature recorded with user ID, timestamp (UTC), and action; audit trail entry created; 21 CFR Part 11 compliant
